spaces.title: Shared
spaces.intro: Create spaces to share files with your colleagues and peers.
spaces.emptyNoSpacesHint: Create one or join with an invite code.
spaces.emptyDocsBody: A space is a private group. Files stay on your device and move straight to the people you invite — there's no server in between.
spaces.emptyNoFavoritesHint: Open a space and choose Add to Favorites from the menu to pin it here.

space.filesErrorHint: The file list took too long to load. This can happen while files are still syncing or a peer is offline.
space.emptyFiles: No files shared yet. Drop files in the sidebar to get started.
space.emptyShareSubtitle: Drag files or folders into the share area on the right to start sharing with this space.
space.emptyShareDocsBody: Members download files straight from your device, so you'll need to be online and running Mirall while they do. Shared files stay where they are on disk — move or delete one and it's no longer available.
space.emptyMembers: No members connected yet. Share the invite code to get started.
space.creatorDivergenceWarning: The owner identity for this space is in conflict — a peer asserted a different owner than the one on record. Approvals are paused; verify with someone you trust before sharing anything sensitive.
space.joinRequestsDesc: Approve people to give them access to this space.
space.waitingApprovalHint: A member of this space needs to approve you. You can leave this open — you'll be let in automatically as soon as someone's online.
space.waitingDocsBody: An invite carries the address of the space, never the key to it. Someone already inside hands that over — so a member has to be online and reachable before you can be let in. Auto-approve removes the decision, not the hand-over.
space.legacyWarning: This space was created by a much older version of Mirall and can no longer be used. Create a new space and share your folders into that one.

connectivity.offlineToast: Network connection lost. Mirall is paused.

blockedToast.generic: Your network is blocking connections to other people. Invites and shares won't arrive.
blockedToast.peers-unreachable: We can find other people but can't connect to them. Invites and shares won't arrive.
blockedToast.os-offline: This device isn't connected to any network.
blockedToast.vpn-only-route: Mirall can't reach the network. Your VPN appears to be the only route out.

atRiskToast.generic: Connections to many people will fail on this network.
atRiskToast.symmetric-nat: Connections to many people will fail on this network. Mobile routers and tethering are the usual cause.

fix.vpn: Turn off your VPN and check again.
fix.mobile: Use a cable or DSL connection instead of a mobile router or phone tethering. On a mobile network there's no router setting that fixes this.
fix.otherNetwork: Try a different Wi-Fi — company and guest networks often filter this traffic.
fix.turnOnNetwork: Turn your Wi-Fi back on, or plug in a network cable.

networkSettings.title: Network
networkSettings.limitSaveFailed: Couldn't save that limit. The previous one is still in use.
networkSettings.floorAdvisory: Mirall uses at least {{min}} KB/s for transfers. A lower limit is rounded up to it.
networkSettings.scopeNote: Limits apply to file transfers. Keeping your spaces and members in sync is not limited — it uses very little data, and slowing it down would stop new folders from appearing.

relays.heading: Relays
relays.desc: A relay helps two devices connect when the network blocks a direct link — a space that never syncs on office Wi-Fi, for example. Relays forward encrypted data only; they cannot read your files.
relays.alwaysWarning: Every connection goes through a relay, even when a direct one would work. Useful for testing, slower for everyday use.
relays.addDesc: Paste the public key of the relay you want to use. Your files stay encrypted end to end — the relay only forwards them.
relays.invalidKey: That does not look like a relay key. Check for a missing or extra character.

verdict.healthyBodyIdle: Ready to share. Nobody else is online right now.
verdict.connectingBody: This is taking longer than expected. Check your firewall, VPN, or ISP.
verdict.offlineBody: Mirall is paused until your network returns.
verdict.unknownBody: Working out how this network behaves.
verdict.at-riskBody: Connections to many people will fail on this network.
verdict.blockedBody: Invites and shares won't arrive while this is the case.

advice.title: Suggestions
advice.osOffline: Your operating system reports no internet connection. Check your Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
advice.firewalled: Your router appears to be blocking inbound UDP. Peers will reach you only via holepunching.
advice.randomizedNat: Your network randomises outbound ports. Direct connections may fail.
advice.symmetricNat: Your connection uses changing ports. Connections to many people will fail — mobile routers and tethering are the usual cause.
advice.noPublicAddr: Couldn't determine your public IP. Check your internet connection.
advice.smallRoutingTable: Few DHT peers known so far. Bootstrap may still be in progress.
advice.stillBootstrapping: Still joining the DHT — give it a moment.
advice.symmetricNatFix: On a mobile network there's no router setting that fixes this. A cable or DSL connection will work.
advice.udpDegraded: Your network keeps dropping traffic to the Mirall network. Transfers may stall.
advice.stillSettling: Still working out how this network behaves — give it a moment.

reachableValue.changingPorts: No — your network uses changing ports
reachableValue.noAddress: No — we can't tell how you appear to others

activityLogSettings.deleteConfirmBody: Every recorded event is removed from this device. This can't be undone.

connectionProblem.title: Connection problem

subtitle.blocked: Mirall can't reach other people from this network.
subtitle.atRisk: Mirall can only reach some people from this network.
subtitle.offline: This device isn't connected to any network.
subtitle.vpnOnly: Your VPN appears to be the only route out.

body.generic: We can find other people on the Mirall network, but we can't connect to them.
body.symmetric-nat: Your connection uses a different port every time it reaches out. Connections to some people will work; to many others they will fail. Mobile routers and phone tethering are the usual cause.
body.no-public-address: We couldn't work out how you appear to the rest of the network, so other people have no way to reach you.
body.peers-unreachable: We can find other people on the Mirall network, but we can't connect to them. While this is the case, invites you send won't arrive and spaces you join won't sync.
body.dht-unreachable: Mirall can't reach the network from here at all.
body.udp-degraded: Your connection to the network keeps dropping traffic, so transfers may stall.
body.os-offline: This device isn't connected to any network.
body.vpn-only-route: Every route on this device goes through a VPN, and nothing is answering through it. If the VPN lost its own connection, Mirall cannot get out either.

stillWorks.blocked: You can still set up spaces — they'll stay on this device and start syncing once the connection works.
stillWorks.atRisk: Sharing will still work with some people.
stillWorks.offline: Spaces you set up now will start syncing as soon as you reconnect.
stillWorks.vpnOnly: Spaces you set up now will start syncing once the connection works.

connectionProblem.recoveredSubtitle: Mirall can reach other people again.
connectionProblem.recoveredBody: Whatever was blocking Mirall has cleared. You can create or join a space.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: If we ask you for details, save this file and send it to us. It describes how your network behaves — not what you share or who you share it with.
diagnostics.redactDescription: Your IP address, keys and space names are shortened or left out. Recommended — this is enough for us to diagnose connection problems.
diagnostics.logsDescription: Turns on detailed logging, then asks you to reproduce the problem before saving.
diagnostics.previewIntro: Identifying details removed. This is exactly what will be saved.
diagnostics.verboseOn: Detailed logging is on. Reproduce the problem, then save the file.
diagnostics.previewIntroRaw: Identifying details are INCLUDED. This is exactly what will be saved.

editFolder.nameOwnedBy: {{owner}} owns this folder, so only they can rename it.
editFolder.sourceDesc: Where the files live on your disk. Point Mirall at a new location and matching files are recognised — nothing is uploaded again.
editFolder.sourceFixed: Where the files live on your disk. Mirall re-points this for you if the folder ever goes missing.
editFolder.mirrorDesc: Where this mirror is stored. Files already at the new location are recognised; anything missing is fetched again.
